profile.name: Deeksha Pal
profile.summary: MCA student with hands-on experience in Python, SQL, MySQL and Power BI. Skilled in data cleaning, EDA, SQL reporting and dashboard development. Seeking an entry-level Data Analyst role.

bullets: Cleaned and validated datasets using Python, SQL and Excel.
Performed EDA and developed SQL reports.
Built dashboards and visualizations for business insights.
Collaborated on analytics and reporting projects.

projects.title: Stock Market Intelligence Analysis
projects.subtitle: Database Architecture & Financial Analytics Platform
projects.description: Designed and implemented a database and reporting schema in MySQL to analyze historical stock transactions. Conducted statistical volatility modeling in Jupyter Notebooks and engineered a financial dashboard in Power BI to track stock trends.
achievements: Collected and cleaned historical stock market data using Python and Pandas.
Performed exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify price trends and market volatility.
Designed MySQL tables and wrote SQL queries for financial reporting and analysis.
Built an interactive Power BI dashboard to visualize stock performance and key metrics.

projects.title: LinkedIn Job Market Analytics
projects.subtitle: Ingestion Pipelines & Talent Supply Dashboarding
projects.description: Designed an analytical project to capture and study tech hiring trends. Structured job profiles to map remote-work allocations, language requirements, and hiring frequencies across geographical software hubs.
achievements: Collected LinkedIn jobs using web scraping and APIs.
Performed cleaning, EDA and SQL reporting.
Built a Power BI dashboard for hiring trends.
Analyzed hiring trends across industries, locations, and work modes to identify recruitment patterns.
Developed interactive Power BI visualizations to compare remote, hybrid, and onsite job opportunities for business reporting.

projects.title: Zomato Restaurant Data Diagnostics & BI Dashboard
projects.subtitle: Exploratory Data Analysis & Pricing Strategy Insights
projects.description: Engineered an end-to-end data analytics workflow on Zomato's restaurant dataset to identify factors driving customer ratings and optimal restaurant locations. Deployed interactive dashboards in Power BI for operational business insights.
achievements: Cleansed and structured raw data using Pandas and NumPy, resolving 15%+ missing geolocation records and inconsistent pricing syntax.
Conducted detailed Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) in Matplotlib and Seaborn, discovering that restaurants offering online ordering carried a 20% higher average rating.
Developed a responsive multi-page Power BI dashboard featuring dynamic drill-downs by location, average cost-for-two, and cuisine categories.
Synthesized critical business expansion recommendations, identifying under-served geographical hubs and high-potential low-competition cuisines.
